program.name: Fighter Express
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Short fight sessions: bouts, then a sprawl EMOM or a core circuit.
program.about: Fight training in a short slot, no gear. Each day opens with a few bouts, then an EMOM of sprawls, push-ups and squats one day and a core circuit the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Bouts & sprawl EMOM / bouts & core circuit, short
